svg.aria-label: Replacing a program one function at a time. The original program keeps running while its functions are replaced by new ones. Each new function is checked against the original before the next
svg.title: Replacing a program one function at a time. The original program keeps running while its functions are replaced by new ones. Each new function is checked against the original before the next
svg.text: REPLACING A PROGRAM ONE FUNCTION AT A TIME
OpenRCT2 and dethrace replaced the original program piece by piece while the game kept running.
Each new function must give the original's answers before the next is replaced. At every step the game runs,
so a mistake shows at once. When every function is replaced, no original code is left.
